build_simclr_model: build a SimCLR model with an MLP head and optional backbone for contrastive learning
run_simclr_forward: run the SimCLR forward pass with two augmented view tensors to compute contrastive loss
create_simclr_with_backbone: create a SimCLR instance with a custom backbone network and temperature parameter
review_simclr_contrastive_loss: review the SimCLR forward method that computes normalized dot product contrastive loss
test_simclr_distributed_gather: test the SimCLR forward pass that gathers x2 embeddings across distributed GPUs
